name: yourclanname-feed-cloudflare-setup
description: self-hosted realtime clan-feed relay for PixelB8 OSRS Clans.

CLAN_FEED_KEY.description: Paste one of your PixelB8 clan keys here. RuneLite must use the same key when publishing the Clan Feed. Keep it private.

CLAN_VIEWER_KEY.description: Paste the Clan Feed Viewer Code from your PixelB8 Clan Owner Office. Clanmates use this for read-only feed access. Keep it private.
